title: Shapes and Solids
parentNote: Gather a dice, a ball, a can, a box, and an ice-cream cone (or a picture of one) — matching real objects to names is the fastest way to lock this in.
learnBullets: Naming solid (3D) shapes: **cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder, cone**
Counting **faces, edges, and corners** of solids
Telling flat (2D) shapes apart from solid (3D) shapes
learnItFirst:
| Solid | Picture | Real object | Faces | Edges | Corners |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cube | 🎲 | Dice | 6 | 12 | 8 |
| Cuboid | 📦 | Box | 6 | 12 | 8 |
| Sphere | ⚽ | Ball | 1 (curved) | 0 | 0 |
| Cylinder | 🥫 | Can | 3 (2 flat + 1 curved) | 2 | 0 |
| Cone | 🍦 | Ice-cream cone | 2 (1 flat + 1 curved) | 1 | 1 |

**Key words:**
- **Face** = a flat (or curved) surface of the solid
- **Edge** = where two faces meet, forming a line
- **Corner (vertex)** = a point where edges meet

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Picture** the real object in your mind (a dice, a ball, a can).
2. **Count** faces first, then edges, then corners.
3. Remember: **round shapes** (sphere, cylinder, cone) have fewer or no corners.

---

questions.content: Which solid shape looks like a dice?
questions.why: A dice has 6 equal square faces, just like a cube

questions.content: Which solid shape looks like a ball?
questions.why: A ball is round on all sides, like a sphere

questions.content: Which solid shape looks like a can of juice?
questions.why: A can has a curved side with flat circular ends, like a cylinder

questions.content: Which solid shape looks like an ice-cream cone?
questions.why: An ice-cream cone has a pointed tip and round base, like a cone

questions.content: Which solid shape looks like a box (a book box)?
questions.why: A box has flat rectangular faces, like a cuboid

questions.content: Which of these is a FLAT (2D) shape?
questions.why: A square is flat and drawn on paper; the others are solids

questions.content: Which of these is a SOLID (3D) shape?
questions.why: A cube takes up space and can be held; the others are flat shapes

questions.content: Which solid shape can roll easily in every direction?
questions.why: A sphere is round all over, so it rolls smoothly everywhere

questions.content: Which solid shape has NO flat face at all?
questions.why: A sphere is entirely curved, with no flat face

questions.content: Which solid shape has flat faces only, so it can be stacked easily?
questions.why: A cuboid has only flat faces, so it stacks neatly

questions.content: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.why: A cube has 6 square faces

questions.content: How many edges does a cube have?
questions.why: A cube has 12 edges

questions.content: How many corners does a cube have?
questions.why: A cube has 8 corners

questions.content: How many faces does a cuboid (box shape) have?
questions.why: A cuboid has 6 rectangular faces

questions.content: How many corners does a sphere have?
questions.why: A sphere is fully round, with no corners

questions.content: How many edges does a sphere have?
questions.why: A sphere has no edges, since it has only one curved surface

questions.content: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
questions.why: A cylinder has 2 flat circular faces (top and bottom)

questions.content: How many corners does a cylinder have?
questions.why: A cylinder has no corners

questions.content: How many flat faces does a cone have?
questions.why: A cone has 1 flat circular face at its base

questions.content: How many corners (vertices) does a cone have?
questions.why: A cone has 1 corner (the pointed tip)

questions.content: Which solid has EQUAL faces, edges, and corners as a cube?
questions.why: A cuboid also has 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 corners, just like a cube

questions.content: Which of these solids has NO corners at all?
questions.why: A sphere has no corners at all

questions.content: A football is closest in shape to which solid?
questions.why: A football is round on all sides, like a sphere

questions.content: A birthday party hat is closest in shape to which solid?
questions.why: A party hat is pointed with a round base, like a cone

questions.content: A matchbox is closest in shape to which solid?
questions.why: A matchbox has flat rectangular faces, like a cuboid

questions.content: If a solid has 6 flat square faces, 12 edges, and 8 corners, what solid is it?
questions.why: 6 equal square faces, 12 edges, 8 corners describes a cube

questions.content: If a solid has 2 flat circular faces, 1 curved face, and 2 edges but no corners, what solid is it?
questions.why: 2 flat circular faces, 1 curved face, 2 edges, no corners describes a cylinder

questions.content: Which solid has only 1 corner (vertex) in total?
questions.why: A cone has exactly 1 corner, at its pointed tip

questions.content: A cube and a cuboid both have 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 corners. What is the MAIN difference between them?

options.A: A cube's faces are all equal squares; a cuboid's faces can be rectangles of different sizes

questions.why: This is the key difference between the two solids

questions.content: Riya rolls a solid on the floor and it rolls smoothly in every direction without stopping at any flat side. Which solid is it MOST LIKELY to be?
questions.why: Only a sphere is round in every direction with no flat sides to stop it
